mapper.select: select checkin_id, user_id, user_name, checkin_date, checkin_time, actions, source from erp_checkin where user_id = #{userId} and checkin_date = #{checkinDate} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into erp_checkin (user_id, user_name, checkin_date, checkin_time, actions, source, remark, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{checkinDate}, #{checkinTime}, #{actions}, #{source}, #{remark}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select count(1) from erp_checkin where user_id = #{userId}
